parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, back, and top.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and defines the overall shape and stability of the cabinet, holding the doors and base in place.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports other components.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood, supporting the weight of stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It distributes the load evenly and provides a stable foundation for the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a solid wood panel attached to the frame with hinges, featuring a handle for opening.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space and protects contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a solid wood panel similar to the left door, attached with hinges and a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the right side of the cabinet’s interior and secures stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.
